title: Fix readyWork.next narrowing typecheck failure and gate closes on pnpm check
description: WHY: pnpm check fails with TS18048 at apps/cli/src/commands.ts line 7673 - status.readyWork.next is narrowed by the if at line 7672 but referenced inside the async store.read closure where TypeScript drops the narrowing. pnpm test passes, which is how five refactor tasks closed with a broken build: their closeout evidence recorded pnpm test but nothing gated on pnpm check. WHAT: (1) fix the error by binding const nextWork = status.readyWork.next before the closure and using it inside; (2) audit the surrounding bwrk next implementation (lines 7640-7700) for the same closure-narrowing pattern; (3) process fix - make typecheck part of the done gate: add pnpm check to the commands the agent guide finish hint recommends for tasks labeled with this repo, and file every future implementation task in this workspace with a declared gate of pnpm check (the declaredCommand feature shipped in the epic exists precisely for this and was not used on the epic itself).
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence on this task includes the pnpm check command with passed outcome
closedReason: pnpm check and full test suite passed
